title: xDrip + blucon + libre does not receive data
symptom: User with Libre 1, blucon, and xDrip on Xiaomi Mi 9T (Android 10) cannot receive data from blucon consistently; sometimes no data, sometimes partial data, but not enough to pass calibration.
cause: The thread suggests the phone has problems connecting to the blucon, possibly due to Bluetooth settings.
fix: Try disabling/enabling 'trust auto connect' and 'use scanning' in xDrip under settings->less common settings->bluetooth options; one of the four combinations should work.
evidence_quote: Please try disabling/enabling "trust auto connect" and "use scanning" Probably one of the 4 possible combinations should work well.
